name: thrust-vscode
description: Runs the Thrust verifier on a Rust file and shows its report: refuted obligations with counterexamples, inferred contracts and loop invariants.

thrust.command.description: The program running Thrust and its leading arguments, for example ["rustup", "run", "nightly-2025-09-08", "/path/to/thrust-rustc"]. For a file on its own the extension appends the extra arguments, --error-format=json, --out-dir and the file; in a cargo workspace cargo's arguments, then the extra arguments.

thrust.cargoCommand.description: The program running cargo and its leading arguments, for a workspace folder with a Cargo.toml, for example ["cargo", "+nightly-2025-09-08"].

thrust.extraArgs.description: Arguments passed before the file, for example ["--crate-type", "lib"] for a file without main; in a cargo workspace, after cargo's arguments to each crate's run.

thrust.env.description: Environment variables for the run, for example THRUST_SOLVER_TIMEOUT_SECS.

thrust.split.description: THRUST_SPLIT: solve the parts of the constraints on their own, that many at a time. 0 solves one query.

thrust.cacheDir.description: THRUST_CACHE_DIR, relative to the workspace folder: keeps the verdict of each part between runs. Empty keeps nothing.

thrust.verifyOnSave.description: Verify a Rust file when it is saved.

thrust.timeoutSecs.description: Seconds after which a run is stopped.

thrust.inlayHints.description: Show the inferred contracts and invariants and the counterexample's facts as inlay hints at the end of their lines.

thrust.codeLens.description: Show a code lens "Verify this function" above each function, which runs Thrust with THRUST_VERIFY_ONLY on that function.
